_readme: S644, 2026-11-13. Reads 1-5 found that Diablo Valley's eLumen catalog prints every award's requirements (content call catalog,program,<slug>, run 43342877522) but lists none of them: its full publish call names no program,<slug> (run 43343491672), so the program index is www.dvc.edu's grid of program areas, whose area pages link each award into eLumen. The grid pages by ?page=0..5 with 13 areas on its first page. This read loads the last grid page once, to count the areas a reader would load (5 x 13 plus this page's). No model call. Answered by run 43344234543 (1 load): the last page lists 12 areas (Philosophy to Work Experience (WRKX) Program) and links no page past it, so the grid holds 77 areas (5 x 13 + 12). No area is named Transfer Studies, so the Cal-GETC and UC7 certificates the eLumen grid lists may sit under no area. This answer was committed under a later commit, so the plan did not run again.

questions.area_count: How many program areas does the grid's last page (?page=5) list, and does it name a page past it?
